name: Tash ma Tash
description: Saudi Arabia's most iconic comedy series, running 19 seasons from 1993 to 2023. Starring beloved duo Nasser Al-Qasabi and Abdullah Al-Sadhan, each episode delivers a self-contained satirical sketch skewering a different facet of Saudi society — from bureaucracy and extremism to marriage, gender relations, and corruption. A Ramadan institution and a landmark of Arab television.

videos.title: The Limousine
videos.overview: Two drivers work for a limousine company, and in their attempt to make the most profit, they cause many problems.

videos.title: Hey My Father's Uncle, Scratch My Back
videos.overview: Nasser finds himself in an unenviable situation when he takes care of his elderly relative, and is forced to live with him and do all the household tasks.

videos.title: Athari
videos.overview: Shaddad goes out to look for pasture in the desert, and loses his provisions. At the same time, Haddad thinks about seizing the opportunity and getting rid of Shaddad after the announcement of his engagement to Adhari, but at the last moment, he changes his mind.

videos.title: Deposit
videos.overview: Abu Musaed, a greedy broker, tries to collect a lot of money, so he rents the villa to several people and receives a deposit from each of them.

videos.title: What Money Buys, Brings Misfortune
videos.overview: Mohammed hires the servant Toofan to work in his house, but he is surprised by his failure to perform his work and is forced to report him to the police.

videos.title: Services 2000
videos.overview: Saud and his colleague collaborate to open an office to provide services, and Saud becomes upset when a father forgets his son with him.

videos.title: Private Clinics
videos.overview: As a young man has a constant headache, he goes to the doctor at the medical clinic. He diagnoses the condition incorrectly every time, and after several surgical operations, he is told that it is an incurable migraine.

videos.title: Private Lessons
videos.overview: Abu Saud suffers due to his son's failure in studies, so he brings him a teacher to help him finish his schoolwork, but he discovers that his son needs another teacher to complete his homework for him.

videos.title: Pull For Me And I Will Cut For You
videos.overview: A contractor tries to provide prices for Al Nasser Company's tender, and Nasser takes advantage of this and offers to help him in exchange for money, and he falls into a great predicament.

videos.title: For Kissing For Lack Of Time
videos.overview: Nasser and Abdullah start several projects, and they fail every time, lose their money, and are eventually forced to apply for government jobs.

videos.title: No worries but wedding worries
videos.overview: Abdullah proposes to marry his cousin, and is upset when he fails to meet the bride and plan with her the basis of their lives together, and his uncle is present every time he tries to talk to her until he gets her divorced.

videos.title: The house is our father's house
Modern Parenting 1
videos.overview: Abu Nasser is a tyrannical manager who treats everyone strictly according to the law, refuses to make things easy for anyone, and believes in raising his son Nasser with modern parenting by accompanying him everywhere.

videos.title: Modern Parenting 2
videos.overview: Abu Nasser tries to help his son study and learn his lessons, but he fails.

videos.title: Vitamin W 1
videos.overview: As Saleh's wife insists on hiring her brother at Saleh's company, he sets certain conditions that apply only to her brother in order for him to hire him. He is surprised by a guy applying for the same job who fulfills all the requirements he set based on his brother-in-law.

videos.title: Vitamin W 2
videos.overview: Abu Nasser is forced to set tests for both employees applying for the job in order to force the new employee to withdraw, but the opposite happens.

videos.title: This Is Your Nose Even If It Was Crooked
Ya Man Shralh Min Halalh Ellatin
Talk the talk, Walk the walk
The truth is what it is
Ruqayya, between a rock and a hard place
The first striker is the worse offender
A day for you and a day against you
Fake it till you make it
The people are in their eyes
The Lightning
videos.overview: After waking up from a seemingly deep sleep in the car, Abu Nizar, Abu Hazar, and their families hurry home, only to discover that they’ve been away for more than eight years.

videos.title: The Eye Is On You
videos.overview: Worried that he will be held accountable, Abu Ali accidentally exposes his past misdeeds, putting himself and everyone around him at risk of being arrested.

videos.title: Blackmail
videos.overview: When Uber driver Fouad finds himself being blackmailed by a female passenger, he is left with no choice but to turn to his father-in-law Asaad for help.

videos.title: The Cold War
videos.overview: Antique collector Abu Sulaiman buys an old clay jar at the flea market that could be the key to his long-awaited happiness.

videos.title: Content Salesman
videos.overview: After being abruptly dismissed by his employer, Abdullah, an experienced journalist, finds himself left with no choice but to work for a famous social media influencer.

videos.title: Meqtaa Haq
videos.overview: Obsessed with enhancing his public image, businessman Adnan squanders money left and right trying to impress one of the local tribes so he can bear their name.

videos.title: Love And Alzheimer’s
videos.overview: When Abu Fahad, an old-timer suffering from Alzheimer’s, visits the neighbourhood he grew up in, he finds out that his old heart is still capable of falling in love.

videos.title: The Emigration Of Men
videos.overview: When the women form a group to eliminate all men, lives are at stake as they find themselves forced to flee the city.

videos.title: The Tedious
videos.overview: Abdulhadi’s visit to the UAE turns into misery when he finds himself obligated to satisfy a clingy man’s whims.

videos.title: Abu Zunayfer Limited
videos.overview: Othman agrees to Abu Zunayfer's business proposal, only to realise later that he may have gotten the short end of the stick.

videos.title: The Family Line
videos.overview: Khaled returns to his old village from Lebanon at his father’s behest, only to discover that his old man plans to marry him off in order to continue the family line.

videos.title: Family Low
videos.overview: Shortly after his wife passes away, Abu Fahad decides to find himself a new partner, forcing his children to seek their uncle’s help in talking some sense into him.

videos.title: Sea Of Women
videos.overview: Hamad finds himself getting on his wife’s bad side when he is transferred to an all-female branch.

videos.title: Mobile Phone Crisis
videos.overview: Seeing how his cell phone is affecting him and his family, Saoud decides to get rid of the device while encouraging them to follow suit, triggering a series of comical events.

videos.title: Life’s Junk
videos.overview: While going through old junk left outside by his wife, a nostalgic Abu Asaad decides to revisit unfixed blunders from the past.

videos.title: Those Were The Days
videos.overview: After being asked to marry a wealthy merchant off to the village bully’s mother, Abu Fahad soon realises that he may have bitten off more than he can chew.

videos.title: Dear Father…
videos.overview: Bothered by what his employees secretly think of him, Mansour is driven to listening in on his family’s conversations about him.

videos.title: Counterattack
videos.overview: Despite her obvious talent, Noura’s father decides not to let her hone her football skills for fear of gossip.

videos.title: Sheen Baa Waw
videos.overview: The police come out in full force after a fire breaks out mysteriously in a house leaving only one survivor behind.

videos.title: Between Two Fires
videos.overview: Finale: After waking up from a long-term coma, a man tries to pick up the pieces of his life, only to find himself facing his wife’s new husband.
